compute_transfer_matrix_knn: compute a transfer matrix using a KNN classifier from embedding states and train test datasets
publish_transfer_matrix: publish transfer matrix values to a metrics writer with source and target task names
log_transfer_summary: log a summary table of KNN transfer weightings sorted by weight for a target task
tabulate_results: build an ASCII table from a list of result rows and column headers for display
review_transfer_matrix_module: review the transfer matrix module to understand KNN classifier evaluation and metrics publishing
